usdRate.sourceName: Central Bank of Syria, official exchange-rate bulletin (new pound)
usdRate.note: 122.00 new Syrian pounds per US dollar in the official bulletin of 29 October 2026 (Trading Economics shows 122.02 on 30 October); rates are quoted in the new pound, so all money figures here are in new pounds. The bank's site carries a demo-version banner. CLDR's '£' is replaced by the local abbreviation ل.س.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Trading Economics, citing the Syrian Center for Policy Research, CPI July 2026
inflation_cpi.note: Consumer prices up 24.8% year on year in July 2026 (40.5% in June); secondary source because no official 2026 CPI was found (the Central Bank of Syria price-index series stops in 2020). World Bank data stops in 2019.

inflation_projection.sourceName: Latest CPI 24.8% (July 2026) after 40.5% in June; exchange rate stable near 122 new pounds per dollar
inflation_projection.note: There is no credible inflation target and inflation is falling fast from very high levels with a steadier pound, so a rounded 15% a year is used, well below today's rate but far above stable economies.

policy_rate.note: The Central Bank of Syria site shows no policy rate; only the weighted average market lending rate (16.23% in June 2026) is published.

savings_account_rate.note: No savings-account rate is published; the Central Bank of Syria deposit-rate series covers only 1-year deposits and stops in March 2022.

fdr_3m_rate.note: No 3-month deposit rate is published by the Central Bank of Syria.

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Syria, weighted average market interest rate on 1-year customer deposits in Syrian pounds
fdr_1y_rate.note: 8.07% in March 2022, the latest value published; older than 2025 and far below current inflation, so treat it as indicative only.

dps_rate.note: No industry-wide rate for a monthly recurring deposit product was found.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Syria, weighted average market interest rates on customer deposits in Syrian pounds
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: 8.07% in March 2022 (1-year deposits), the latest value published; older than 2025. World Bank FR.INR.DPST has no recent Syrian data.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: Investment certificates (شهادات الاستثمار) were sold to the public (Central Bank of Syria series of amounts outstanding, to June 2022), but no current rate or terms were found.

tbill_91d_rate.note: The Central Bank of Syria lists treasury bill and bond auction results up to issue 6 of 2024 only as PDF titles; no yield could be read.

tbond_5y_rate.note: Treasury bonds of 1 to 30 years are auctioned (latest listed issue 6 of 2024), but no yield could be read.

tbond_10y_rate.note: Treasury bonds of 1 to 30 years are auctioned (latest listed issue 6 of 2024), but no 10-year yield could be read.

tax_bank_interest.note: The tax rate on bank interest for individuals could not be confirmed from an official source; no PwC Tax Summary covers Syria.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: The tax treatment of investment-certificate returns could not be confirmed from an official source.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: No deposit insurance scheme or cover limit could be confirmed from the Central Bank of Syria site.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap or published credit card rate was found; the market lending rate averaged 16.23% in June 2026 (Central Bank of Syria).

equity_return_low.sourceName: Central Bank of Syria 1-year deposit rate 8.07% (2022); inflation 24.8% (July 2026)
equity_return_low.note: Low case: the small local market, recovering from war and sanctions, returns less than deposits in pounds.

equity_return_base.sourceName: Central Bank of Syria 1-year deposit rate 8.07% (2022); market lending rate 16.23% (June 2026)
equity_return_base.note: Base case: about 3 points above the deposit rate, within the 4-point cap, because the local index has a weak, war-distorted 10-year record.

equity_return_high.note: High case: share prices keep pace with high inflation as the economy recovers.

gold_return_low.sourceName: Official rate 122 new pounds per USD (October 2026); inflation assumption 15%
gold_return_low.note: Low case: flat dollar gold with modest pound depreciation.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Official rate 122 new pounds per USD (October 2026); inflation assumption 15%; long-run dollar gold trend
gold_return_base.note: Base case: dollar gold up about 4% a year plus about 10% a year of pound depreciation, in line with the inflation gap to the dollar.

gold_return_high.sourceName: Official rate 122 new pounds per USD (October 2026); latest inflation 24.8%
gold_return_high.note: High case: renewed pound weakness at today's inflation rate.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: Central Bank of Syria 1-year deposit rate 8.07% (2022)
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: deposit rates below the last published level, before any tax.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: Central Bank of Syria 1-year deposit rate 8.07% (2022)
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: a little below the last published 1-year deposit rate to allow for tax on interest, which could not be confirmed.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: Central Bank of Syria 1-year deposit rate 8.07% (2022); market lending rate 16.23% (June 2026)
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: deposit rates rise toward inflation as monetary policy normalises.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: No industry-wide life claim settlement ratio was found from the insurance supervisor.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: No published term-life premium rates per 1,000 pounds of cover were found.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical cost of a major private hospital stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: No published private health insurance premiums by age were found.

oop_health_share.sourceName: World Bank WDI, out-of-pocket expenditure (% of current health expenditure), Syria
oop_health_share.note: 72.4% in 2023 (WHO Global Health Expenditure Database via the World Bank); older than 2025, the latest available.

goal_inflation_health.note: No medical CPI was found; with most health spending paid out of pocket and many imported medicines, 2 points above the inflation assumption.

goal_inflation_education.note: No education CPI was found; private schooling costs tend to rise faster than prices, so 2 points above the inflation assumption.

life_expectancy.sourceName: World Bank WDI, life expectancy at birth, total (SP.DYN.LE00.IN), Syria

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium variant for 2026; totals at 60, 70 and 80 are the mean of men and women (only the 65 total is published there).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 7.25 (2025, World Bank), 11.0 (2040) and 22.0 (2065, populationpyramid.net/syrian-arab-republic/2065/).

retirement_age_default.note: The private-sector pension age under the social insurance law could not be confirmed from an official or allowed secondary source.

retirement_age_government.note: The retirement age for government employees could not be confirmed from an official source.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: Central Bank of Syria 1-year deposit rate 8.07% (2022)
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: deposit rates below the last published level.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: Central Bank of Syria 1-year deposit rate 8.07% (2022)
retirement_return_base.note: Base case: below the last published 1-year deposit rate, allowing for tax on interest that could not be confirmed.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: Central Bank of Syria 1-year deposit rate 8.07% (2022); market lending rate 16.23% (June 2026)
retirement_return_high.note: High case: deposit rates rise somewhat as policy normalises.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Central Bank of Syria 1-year deposit rate 8.07% (2022); equity low case 5%; gold low case 6%
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case: a mix earning about deposit rates.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Deposit rate 8.07% (2022); equity base 11%; gold base 14%
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: a mix of deposits, some local shares and a larger gold share, as is common where the currency is weak.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case: a growth and gold-leaning mix that keeps pace with high inflation.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: No non-contributory old-age (social) pension and amount could be confirmed from an official source.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: No non-contributory old-age pension eligibility rules could be confirmed from an official source.

gratuity_rule.note: No statutory end-of-service gratuity rule for private employees could be confirmed; the labour law text could not be read.

public_pension_scheme.note: A contributory social insurance scheme covers public and private employees, but its pension age, indexation and tax rules could not be read from an official source.

fdr_1y.note: The latest published average rate on 1-year pound deposits is 8.07% (March 2022).

dps.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product was found.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: Government-backed investment certificates were sold to the public; the Central Bank of Syria series of amounts outstanding ends in June 2022 and current terms were not found.

tbill_91d.note: Bills under one year are auctioned to banks; the latest listed issue is from 2024.

tbond_5y.note: Bonds of 1 to 30 years are auctioned to banks; the latest listed issue is from 2024.

tbond_10y.note: Bonds of 1 to 30 years are auctioned to banks; the latest listed issue is from 2024.

equity_fund.note: No diversified mutual or index fund for retail investors was found; only individual shares trade on the local exchange.

gold.note: Gold coins, small bars and jewellery are widely bought as savings.
